g.text: DETERMINISTIC SPINE: rules over recorded evidence govern claims, actions and release.
G1 · Source Reach, Knowledge Ingress & Lifecycle

text.tspan: Legend. Each container is a capability group. Each cell names a capability and its contract. Green marks the knowledge plane. Blue-grey marks the
operational plane. A red rule marks a truth control. The dashed group contains cross-cutting capabilities. Grey edges show the order used for a request.
Colours show design roles. An organisation can add assessment data to each cell.
Route intent to governed answer surfaces
Generate and serve mastered operational products
Bind provenance into the record and propagate lineage
Evaluate governed query policy across dialects
Validate the brain as a model
Bound cross-user promotion by consent and de-identification
Establish consent or lawful basis for protected release
Account for unit cost and budget
Scale with scope and trust-boundary isolation

g.text: reach and admit, then retrieve and understand
resolve what is true and where it came from
then decide who may see it
under a governance and lawful-basis frame
and judged on the value it returns
and runs on the durable substrate
